name: SAL - Status update
description: Minutes of a status meeting: progress by activity, decisions, actions, risks and next steps.
description_it: Minuta di una call di avanzamento: stato per attività, decisioni, azioni, rischi e prossimi passi.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: 3-5 sentences: why the call took place, the overall state of the work and the main outcome. A reader who only reads this must know what happened

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: Real names of the people who took part, from the speaker names or from people addressed by name. Never list generic labels such as 'Speaker A' or 'Parlante B': if there are unnamed speakers, end with one item 'Other unnamed speakers'. If no real name appears, write 'Not stated'

sections.title: Activity Status
sections.instruction: One row per activity, phase or deliverable explicitly discussed. Status is one of: Done, In progress, Blocked, Not started. Notes hold what was said about it (percentages, estimates, dates) only if stated

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Only points on which the participants explicitly agreed, each with its context in a few words. Proposals or ideas still to evaluate are not decisions

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every task someone took on. 'Who' and 'By when' only if stated in the call, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Risks and Blockers
sections.instruction: Risks, delays, dependencies or blockers that were raised, with impact and mitigation only if discussed

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: What happens after this call, including follow-up meetings or deadlines with their date only if stated
